# Prayer Times for Mac

> Prayer Times is a native macOS menu bar app for Islamic prayer times (namaz / salah), using Diyanet prayer-time data. It requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later.

Prayer Times shows the current prayer period and a live countdown until that period ends, rather than labeling the next prayer as the current prayer. Clicking the menu bar item opens the daily prayer-time panel. It is an independent app, not an official Diyanet application.

The app supports automatic location detection or manual country/province/district selection, per-prayer notifications at prayer time and/or 5–60 minutes before, four panel layouts (Cards, Sky, List, Boxes), a Hijri date, and launch at login. Previously downloaded monthly prayer times work offline; fetching new times requires a network connection.

The interface supports 14 languages: English, Turkish, Arabic, Persian, Urdu, Indonesian, Malay, Bosnian, Albanian, Azerbaijani, German, French, Dutch, and Russian. Arabic, Persian, and Urdu use right-to-left layouts.

Türkçe: Prayer Times, macOS 14 ve üzeri için menü çubuğunda çalışan bir namaz vakti uygulamasıdır. Diyanet verileri, mevcut vakit için geri sayım, bildirimler ve indirilen aylık vakitler için çevrimdışı erişim sunar.

Homebrew installation: `brew install --cask lutfullahkabalak/tap/prayer-times`. This uses the developer-maintained third-party tap, not the official Homebrew Cask repository. The release supports Intel and Apple Silicon.

- [Official project website](https://lutfullahkabalak.github.io/prayer-times-for-mac/): Turkish overview, screenshots, requirements, and FAQ.

- [Prayer-time data provider](https://ezanvakti.imsakiyem.com): API serving Diyanet prayer times.
- [Developer-maintained Homebrew tap](https://github.com/lutfullahkabalak/homebrew-tap): Cask definition, installation, and update instructions.
